tasks.design: Configure native excavation/provenance links and object fields in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM}. Keep full scientific reading, actual examination, dating/authentication judgement and new findings/checks before separate save; reduce navigation and stable identifiers only.
tasks.previous_blocker: Examining an object can repeat provenance navigation and identifier entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and selected-object fields reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Dating, authenticity and significance need evidence and material examination.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher distinguishes a plausible attribution from one supported by context and physical evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated archaeological source and record work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source/object fields can reduce administration; archaeological authentication and interpretation remain scientific judgement.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual excavation/collection owners supply provenance records; researcher verifies them and produces actual observations. No automated dating or authenticity inference assumed.

New findings and complete checking retained; only stable identifiers reduced. Existing links/prefill earns zero saving. Actual public release or collection-status change is a separate final-version action with no saving claimed.
